hostname ix-w05
!
vrrp enable
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  ip address 192.0.2.1/30
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  ip address 198.51.100.2/24
  ipv6 address 2001:db8:0:10::2/64
  vrrp 1 ip 198.51.100.1
  vrrp 1 priority 110
  vrrp 1 timers advertisement 2
  vrrp 2 ipv6 fe80::1
  vrrp 2 ipv6 2001:db8:0:10::1
  vrrp 2 priority 110
  vrrp 2 timers advertisement csec 50
  no shutdown
!
ip route default 192.0.2.2
!
